name: decline
notes: HARDWARE GESTURE TABLE, whole-arm revision. Offsets from the resting pose. LOOKS LIKE: a slow, deliberate 'no' — the base yaws +/-15 deg through two full cycles while the wrist counter-rolls on joint5 and joint6, with the shoulder slightly set and the elbow lifted so the whole arm sways rather than just the base spinning. Peak 12.5 deg/s (ceiling 15). The counter-roll is what makes it read as a headshake instead of a turntable.
